questions.prompt: Revenue is R(x) = 25x and cost is C(x) = 400 + 9x dollars for x items. Write the profit function P(x) in simplest form and find P(50).
questions.prompt_markup:
Revenue is R(x) = 25x and cost is C(x) = 400 + 9x dollars for x items.
Write the profit function P(x) in simplest form and find P(50).
questions.grading_note: Form required: P(x) simplified and the value. P = R - C.

questions.prompt: A ball's height is h(t) = -4.9t² + 30t + 2 meters after t seconds. Name the three simple functions added together, and what each one describes.
questions.prompt_markup:
A ball's height is h(t) = -4.9t² + 30t + 2 meters after t seconds.
Name the three simple functions added together, and what each one describes.
questions.correct_answer: The constant 2 (the starting height), the linear 30t (height gained from the upward speed), and the quadratic -4.9t² (the pull of gravity).
questions.grading_note: Any equivalent description of the three parts.

questions.prompt: The temperature of tea is T(t) = 20 + 70(0.9)^t °C after t minutes. Which description fits this combination of functions?
questions.prompt_markup:
The temperature of tea is T(t) = 20 + 70(0.9)^t °C after t minutes.
Which description fits this combination of functions?

choices.text: An exponential function that grows 90% per minute
A constant room temperature of 20 °C plus a difference of 70(0.9)^t that decays

questions.correct_answer: A constant room temperature of 20 °C plus a difference of 70(0.9)^t that decays
questions.grading_note: The constant 20 is added to an exponential decay term that starts at 70.
